jobs.title: Analyst - Working Capital & Trade Finance
jobs.description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

The Analyst, Working Capital & Trade Finance (WCTF) role is a position focused on building the analytical, execution, risk management, and client-support capabilities needed to contribute across origination, structuring, implementation, and transaction monitoring. The Analyst supports senior team members in evaluating and executing new and existing WCTF transactions while developing a strong understanding of the Bank's working capital solutions, internal processes, and control framework.

  

The role requires accuracy, accountability, intellectual curiosity, and effective collaboration in a fast-paced environment. Analysts are expected to deliver high-quality work with appropriate guidance, manage assigned responsibilities and competing priorities, raise questions and issues promptly, and assume greater ownership as their product knowledge, judgment, and execution capabilities develop.

  

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Transaction Analysis, Structuring & Execution**

* Support the analysis, structuring, approval, implementation, and closing of new and existing WCTF transactions under the guidance of senior team members.
* Prepare accurate financial analyses, working capital assessments, transaction economics, ROE/RORA simulations, pricing and obligor limit analyses, deal sheets, and screening materials.
* Assess transaction risks, structural considerations, and key assumptions; identify inconsistencies and escalate questions with supporting analysis.
* Prepare term sheets, approval materials, presentations, implementation submissions, documentation inputs, and closing deliverables.
Coordinate assigned workstreams, timelines, and follow-ups across internal stakeholders, promptly escalating risks, delays, or unresolved items.  

  

**Origination & Client Support**

* Support client pitches, product proposals, peer analyses, and other marketing materials in partnership with senior Originators and Structurers.
* Research prospective clients, industries, and market developments to evaluate the applicability of WCTF solutions and inform transaction analysis.
* Participate in internal and external calls, prepare meeting materials and follow-up items, and support timely responses to Relationship Manager and client inquiries.
* Communicate pipeline and transaction updates for assigned opportunities clearly and accurately.
Develop an understanding of client objectives, constraints, and transaction requirements while operating within the Bank's risk appetite.  

  

**Risk Management, Controls & Professional Accountability**

* Perform responsibilities in accordance with applicable credit policies, regulatory requirements, KYC standards, internal controls, and the Bank's risk appetite.
* Support monitoring and reporting for assigned WCTF assets, including performance, utilization, obligor exposure, and transaction requirements; escalate deterioration, operational issues, or control concerns promptly.
* Apply disciplined quality control to all work products, ensuring information is accurate, complete, consistent, and appropriately supported.
* Identify and escalate potential credit, operational, compliance, information security, data integrity, or conduct issues and support timely remediation.
Demonstrate accountability, reliability, sound judgment, and clear communication while managing multiple assignments and deadlines.  

  

**Collaboration, Development & Process Improvement**

* Collaborate effectively across WCTF, the broader Working Capital organization, and other functions throughout the Bank.
* Build product, credit, industry, market, legal documentation, systems, and execution knowledge and apply that learning to assigned responsibilities.
* Incorporate feedback, address knowledge gaps through training and self-study, and progressively assume greater ownership of assigned work.
* Contribute to process improvement, standardization, automation, artificial intelligence, and special projects that enhance efficiency, reporting quality, or risk management.
Share knowledge and best practices to support team effectiveness and consistent execution.  

  

**Qualification** **s:**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree from a four-year accredited institution, preferably with coursework in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.
* Foundational financial analysis and modeling skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to learn new products, industries, systems, and transaction structures.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments, follow through on commitments, and meet deadlines with appropriate oversight.
* High attention to detail, commitment to data accuracy, and awareness of risk and control responsibilities.
* Collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and willingnes

jobs.description:
**Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) / Licensed Behavior Analyst (LBA)**

**Location(s): PASSAIC, NJ | In Home**

**Service Areas:** Passaic County: Paterson, Clifton, Passaic, Haledon, North Haledon, Prospect Park, Hawthorne, Totowa, Woodland Park, Little Falls, and surrounding communities.

Specific assignments and schedules are based on current service needs and geographic availability.

**Employment Type: W-2 | Per Diem, Part-Time**  
**Reports To: Clinical Leadership**

**Compensation: $65-$75/HR. + Bonus**  
**Schedule:** Flexible | The greatest service need is generally during after-school and early evening hours, although opportunities may vary based on individual family needs.

**About Step Up Family Services:** At Step Up Family Services, we believe meaningful change begins with meeting individuals and families where they are. We provide individualized, high-quality behavioral health services that build on individual strengths and create lasting progress in the communities we serve.

Our Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services support children and families through evidence-based interventions delivered in home, center-based, and community settings. We are seeking dedicated BCBA/LBA professionals who are passionate about clinical excellence, developing Behavior Technicians, and helping children achieve meaningful outcomes.

**Why Join Our Team?**

* **Competitive Compensation:** $65–$75 per hour, plus bonus opportunities.
* **Flexible Scheduling:** Full-time, part-time, and per diem opportunities.
* **Professional Growth:** CEU reimbursement, ongoing development, and clinical leadership opportunities.
* **Supportive Team:** Collaborative clinical and operational support so you can focus on delivering high-quality care.

**Position Summary**: The **BCBA/LBA** provides clinical leadership and oversight of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services for children and families served by Step Up Family Services. This role is responsible for conducting assessments, developing and monitoring individualized treatment and Behavior Support Plans (BSPs), analyzing client progress, supervising and developing BTs/RBTs, and partnering with families to support meaningful and sustainable outcomes.

The BCBA/LBA is expected to exercise independent clinical decision-making while maintaining high standards of ethical practice, documentation, collaboration, and regulatory compliance.

**Schedule**

* Scheduling is based on assigned caseload, authorized service hours, client/family needs, and program availability
* Step Up provides services Monday through Sunday between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM
* During the school year, in-home service needs are primarily concentrated after school and on weekends
* Position may include in-home, center-based, community-based, and virtual clinical responsibilities, as appropriate to the service and case
* Travel to assigned client locations is required for in-home and community-based services

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive client assessments and Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) and use findings to identify treatment priorities and clinical recommendations.
* Develop, implement, monitor, and modify individualized treatment plans and Behavior Support Plans (BSPs) based on assessment findings, client needs, family input, and measurable clinical goals.
* Analyze client data and treatment outcomes to evaluate effectiveness, identify barriers to progress, and make data-informed clinical decisions and treatment modifications.
* Provide ongoing supervision, observation, coaching, and clinical direction to BTs/RBTs, ensuring treatment fidelity, staff competency, and appropriate implementation of treatment protocols.
* Partner with parents and caregivers through education, training, modeling, and ongoing communication to promote treatment consistency and generalization of skills across environments.
* Collaborate with families, BTs/RBTs, clinical leadership, schools, providers, and other members of the care team to support coordinated and clinically appropriate care.
* Maintain ownership of assigned caseloads, including authorized service hours, supervision requirements, scheduling, reassessments, treatment-plan updates, and required clinical documentation.
* Identify and appropriately respond to clinical, ethical, safety, or professional-boundary concerns, including consultation and escalation when necessary.
* Complete all clinical documentation, assessments, treatment plans, supervision records, and other required records accurately and within established timeframes, utilizing Step Up’s required electronic systems.
* Maintain compliance with BACB ethical requirements, New Jersey licensure requirements, payer/funding requirements, Step Up policies, and all applicable professional and regulatory standards.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or higher in Applied Behavior Analysis, Psychology, Education, or another qualifying related field.
* Demonstrated experience providing ABA services and developing individualized behavioral treatment interventions.
* Experience conducting FBAs, developing treatment/BSPs, analyzing clinical data, and modifying interventions based on client progress.
* Experience supervising, coaching, or developing BTs/RBTs or other direct-care clinical staff.
* Strong clinical decision-making, communication, organization, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively and independently across in-home and/or center-based environments while maintaining strong collaboration with families and the broader clinical team.
* Reliable transportation and ability to travel to assigned client homes, community settings, or Step Up centers as required.
* Must successfully meet all required background checks, fingerprinting, credentialing, training, and other employment requirements.

**Credential Requirements**

* Must hold and maintain an active Board-Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification through the Behavior

jobs.title: Transaction Management Operations Analyst - Wealth Management Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

  
  

**Job Description:**
  
This job is responsible for moderately complex transaction and fulfillment processing, including the movement of assets into and out of accounts. Key responsibilities include reconciliation, settlement, and trade and transfer support, and providing quality service and operations support for internal business partners and external clients, in accordance with established guidelines and procedures. Job expectations include handling in operational processes which may carry medium to high levels of monetary risk and assisting in training less experienced team members.

  
  

**Line of Business Job Description:**

The Institutional Retirement Payroll, Benefits, and Disbursements (IRBPD) Team within Wealth Management Operations (WMO) is responsible for payroll and benefits processing, money movement, participant-level maintenance and tax reporting support for 401(k) Defined Contribution, Non-Qualified Deferred Compensation (NQDC), Institutional Trust and Custody, Defined Benefit and Health Benefits Solutions (HBS) products.

  
  

The 401(k) Benefits Processing team is responsible for administering 401(k) plans for a large number of employers, including many Fortune 500 companies. Products supported include 401(k) defined contribution.

The Benefits Processing Team facilitates the processing of 401(k) distribution transactions including Qualified Domestic Relations Orders (QDRO), hardship withdrawals, loans, and beneficiary support. The team assists internal partners to facilitate requests originated by 401(k) participants and by the plan sponsors of the companies we service.

  
  

This team is responsible for accurately creating and reviewing 401(k) financial transactions involving stock, money market, and mutual fund trading. Daily functions include processing withdrawals, funds transfers, QDRO & beneficiary transactions, contributions and loan repayments within the Service Level Agreement timeline for our clients.

The Transaction Management Analyst should expect to learn the 401(k) product as well as the skills needed to build a strong foundation for a career in financial services. The candidate must demonstrate a cooperative and professional work attitude, while displaying the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Performs moderately complex transaction processing and reconciliation with medium to large monetary impact according to the established written guidelines and procedures
* Responds to moderately complex client inquiries via numerous channels to support operational efficiency and quality client service
* Responsible for the analysis and resolution of moderately complex transactions requiring escalations and exceptions
* Proactively identifies risk and opportunities for process improvements based on an understanding of how the work impacts other operational units
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Highly organized
* Self-starter attitude and demonstrates initiative
* Ability to multi-task and handle multiple projects in a short time period
* Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to hold others accountable without direct supervision
* Flexibility with ability to handle a variety of tasks and projects independently
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to influence/challenge and negotiate to keep all parties engaged in the process
* Proven ability to provide comprehensive solutions to complex needs and/or problem
* Ability to prioritize and meets established deadlines
* Proficient Microsoft Excel and Word skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to adapt to a changing environment  

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or 3+ years of experience in Financial Services is preferred
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and Word skills
* Familiarity with 401(k) product and MLII/iGate applications
  

  

**Skills:**

* Attention to Detail
* Customer and Client Focus
* Oral Communications
* Prioritization
* Problem Solving
* Account Management
* Analytical Thinking
* Coaching
* Written Communications
* Mentoring
* Research
* Result Orientation
  

  

Internal employees who are currently working from home are still eligible to apply. However, if selected for the role, you may be required to work onsite in accordance with the workplace excellence policy.

**Shift:**

1st shift (United States of America)

**Hours Per Week:**

40

**The Team**

Credit Ratings is an integral part of S&P Global's Global Ratings Services, bringing together a diverse group of more than 1,400 analysts across key financial centers worldwide. The Corporates Ratings practice assesses the creditworthiness of companies across industries by analyzing business risk, strategy, competitive position, and financial performance to produce independent rating opinions that support transparent, comparable decision-making. Within this practice, the Media, Telecommunications, and Business Services team translates sector and company fundamentals into clear, forward-looking views on resilience across cycles — incorporating emerging themes such as AI-driven business change and shifting consumer and demand dynamics.

  
  

**Responsibilities and Impact**

Impact

This role plays a key part in delivering the independent, rigorous credit analysis that underpins S&P Global Ratings' trusted, decision-ready intelligence. The Senior Analyst leads analysis for an assigned portfolio of companies across the Media, Telecommunications, and Business Services sectors, synthesizing complex financial and market data into clear, committee-ready rating opinions. By integrating AI-enabled tools with deep analytical expertise, the role drives productivity, quality, and consistency across the credit process — contributing to analysis that informs investors, issuers, and market participants globally.

  
  

Responsibilities

Team Contribution & Capability Building

* Provide day-to-day coaching and guidance to Research Assistants and Rating Analysts, building capability in credit analysis, data discipline, and analytical tooling while reinforcing values-driven behaviors.
* Drive consistency and scalability by codifying standard work and promoting the disciplined adoption of shared analytical practices across the team.
* Strengthen AI-enabled productivity by developing reusable assets and proposing lightweight automations that free capacity for higher-value human analysis and relationship work.
* Partner with senior team members and Data and Engineering colleagues to identify, design, and scale AI and automation use cases with governance built in from the outset.

Core Analytical & Delivery

* Lead end-to-end execution for assigned credits, ensuring high-quality analysis and timely delivery with clear accountability across priorities.
* Own ongoing surveillance for an assigned portfolio, synthesizing performance data, market signals, and peer context into decision-useful insights with clear risk implications.
* Support the embedding of AI and automation tools into analytical workflows, applying structured validation and analytical judgment to maintain the integrity and reliability of conclusions.
* Prepare and review key analytical outputs — including model inputs, metrics, assumptions, and published reports — ensuring alignment with methodology, sector frameworks, and evidentiary standards.

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

* Engage with external parties alongside senior team members, communicating complex analysis clearly and with credibility.
* Craft client- and executive-ready narratives that translate data, research, and analysis into clear, actionable stories for diverse audiences.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships through collaborative, adaptable, and analytically confident delivery.

Risk Management and Operating

* Ensure adherence to methodology, confidentiality requirements, and data governance standards; escalate issues early with clear options and recommendations to protect analytical integrity.
* Embed responsible, governed AI use into day-to-day workflows, using only approved tools and data while protecting confidential information at all times.

Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications. jobs.title: Strategy and Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
About Ropes & Gray:

Ropes & Gray is a preeminent global law firm. The firm has been ranked in the top three on *The American Lawyer's* prestigious A-List for eight consecutive years and #1 on *Law.com's* UK A-List twice in the past three years - rankings that honor the "best of the best" law firms.  
  
The firm has approximately 2,500 lawyers and professionals serving clients in major centers of business, finance, technology, and government in Boston, Chicago, Dublin, Hong Kong, London, Los Angeles, Milan, New York, Paris, San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, Silicon Valley, Singapore, Tokyo and Washington, D.C.  
  
The firm has consistently been recognized for its leading practices in many areas, including asset management, private equity, M&A, finance, real estate, tax, antitrust, life sciences, health care, intellectual property, litigation & enforcement, privacy & cybersecurity, and business restructuring.  
  
Ropes & Gray is an equal opportunity employer.

Overview:

**About the Strategy team**

A key component of Ropes & Gray’s success is a strategy team that supports the firm’s leadership in making a wide range of strategic business decisions through rigorous research, analysis, and assessment. The strategy team enjoys the trust of Ropes & Gray’s leadership and is called upon to advise on important strategic decisions about the firm’s future. The wide range of practice areas at Ropes & Gray and the broad array of client segments and geographic markets that the firm serves result in strategy team projects that span many disciplines – indeed, no two projects are alike – and variety is the name of the game. Strategy team members have diverse backgrounds, but share an immutable commitment to the excellence of our work product and to the growth and development of team members. We are dedicated professionals, we work together as a team that has a strong sense of purpose, and take great pride in our collective success.

**About** ***you***

We are looking for a special individual to join us. Ropes & Gray is an exceptional firm and a special place to work. The strategy team is a group of highly capable, humble, and deeply committed professionals with an impressive track record of excellence in all that we do. You are our ideal candidate if you are curious, self-motivated, patient, and poised; enjoy working in an environment where team members are supportive and have each other’s backs; possess an innate desire to own and complete assignments to the highest standard in a timely manner; and have experience, aptitude, and interest in both quantitative and qualitative business analytics. As a member of the strategy team, you will feel vested in the team’s success and will care about the professional experience of colleagues. You will enjoy working on a wide variety of strategy projects that are challenging and provide opportunities for growth.

Responsibilities:

* *Research and a**nalysis*, which is a cornerstone for every analyst. This means you get to be curious and learn every day. You will independently gather, analyze, structure, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative business, external market, and competitor data and information, as well as examine aspects of the firm’s client base, capabilities, and economics – to find patterns and begin to draw implications.
* *Project management and work planning*, which includes a broad range of responsibilities from developing hypotheses and figuring out how to explore them to applying effective time management skills to balance multiple efforts and consistently meet deadlines – all while ensuring the highest level of accuracy, organization, documentation, communication, and follow-through.
* *Emerging decision support*, which starts with the presentation of findings through compelling and logical deliverables such as qualitative and quantitative exhibits, as well as discrete sections of written reports. This involves working closely and iteratively with teammates to create polished, client-ready deliverables.

Qualifications:

**You are the right person for the job if you**:

* Are, first and foremost, adaptable and flexible given the dynamic nature of the strategy team’s work and evolving demands and priorities.
* Have an aptitude for complex research and analytical work and demonstrated strengths and interest in problem solving.
* Are able to work in a self-directed manner, take ownership of work, and contribute to the success of the team.
* Are willing to receive and provide constructive feedback.
* Are capable of multi-tasking, sometimes under time-sensitive conditions.
* Possess strong communication skills including written, verbal, and listening.
* Like to collaborate, build relationships, and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Have advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and Word skills.
* Have an undergraduate degree and a minimum of two years of relevant experience, ideally in a professional services environment.

Compensation and Total Rewards Package:

Ropes & Gray is proud to offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package to our business support team members. The firm also offers comprehensive health and well-being benefits, personal and professional development, career growth opportunities and a collegial and supportive culture. jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

**Position Overview:**

jobs.description:
Sound Off® creates immersive audio experiences using wireless headphone technology for events, conferences, fitness, wellness, and experiential activations around the world.

We work with global brands, event producers, and wellness professionals—including Live Nation, Lululemon, and Encore—to transform events through sound. Backed by an experienced network of creative partners and a growing library of customer stories, we are looking for a sharp, hands-on marketing leader to translate strategy into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable growth.

**In lieu of a cover letter, please answer all custom screening questions and provide the requested work sample using the supporting-document option at the end of the application, before submitting.**

**Applications missing these responses or the work sample will not be considered for this role.**

**Our Values**

***Creative Hustle*** – Move fast, solve problems, and find a way forward.

***Experience Over Everything*** – Every touchpoint should feel thoughtful, polished, and memorable.

***Trust Through Ownership*** – Take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

***Collaboration with Clarity*** – Create visibility, alignment, and accountability through systems and communication.

**The Role**

The Marketing and Creative Operations Manager leads the planning, coordination, and performance of Sound Off’s marketing initiatives, reporting directly to and working closely with the CEO. This is a part-time player-coach role designed for someone who thrives at moving between strategy and project orchestration.

Because this is a part-time position, your primary focus is establishing priorities, setting creative direction, and directing execution through our internal and external creative resources. You will own the marketing calendar, campaign strategy, creative standards, and performance oversight. Direct, hands-on execution on your end will focus on high-priority campaign setups, creative briefs, and high-stakes launches.

**Marketing Leadership & CEO Alignment**

* Partner closely with the CEO to translate overall business strategy into actionable marketing priorities, campaign calendars, and launch plans.

* Lead marketing strategy and campaign execution to drive brand awareness and attendance for Sound Off’s fitness, yoga, wellness, and experiential activations.
* Build and guide partnerships with studios, fitness creators, wellness instructors, run clubs, and lifestyle venues.
* Translate community engagement and organic event interest into commercial lead opportunities for Sales.
* Ensure campaign messaging speaks authentically to fitness and wellness audiences and industry partners.

**Social Media & Content Strategy**

* Direct Sound Off’s overarching content strategy across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

**Event Marketing & Digital Operations**

* Partner with RevOps to align campaign tracking, CRM data, and funnel performance.
* Provide high-level guidance for paid social campaigns (objectives, audience targeting, creative direction, and budget allocation).

**Brand Standards, Creative & Community Oversight**

* Maintain visual and verbal brand standards, maintaining a high bar for creative quality.
* Set priorities for creator, influencer, and community outreach, helping turn organic engagement into commercial opportunities for Sales.
* Personally manage high-value strategic relationships or major partner co-promotions.
* Lead recurring marketing check-ins, establish documentation for core workflows, and keep leadership informed with concise, performance-driven reporting.

Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.  
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/16/26.  
  
**Work You'll Do**  
  
As a Project - Lead Analytics and Insights Engineer II on the project, you will:
  

* Support the nationwide implementation of a case management platform across client offices, used for docketing, scheduling, case tracking, and caseload reporting.
* Deliver onsite and virtual training to attorneys, legal staff, and administrative personnel
* Provide user support during and after deployment
* Troubleshoot user issues, documenting recurring problems, developing knowledge resources, and helping users transition case management platforms

The successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  
**The Team**  
  
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  
  
Our Forensic, Discovery, & Financial Crime offering provides services to support anti-money laundering, discovery, business disputes and investigations. Protect brands from financial crime and other corporate misconduct, as well as enable government organizations with tradecraft & technology to combat emerging and evolving threats.  
  
The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Required**:** < >

Preferred:
  
Experience with Palantir software.  

  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. **Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) / Licensed Behavior Analyst (LBA)**

**Location(s): PASSAIC, NJ | In Home**

**Service Areas:** Passaic County: Paterson, Clifton, Passaic, Haledon, North Haledon, Prospect Park, Hawthorne, Totowa, Woodland Park, Little Falls, and surrounding communities.

Specific assignments and schedules are based on current service needs and geographic availability.

**Employment Type: W-2 | Per Diem, Part-Time**  
**Reports To: Clinical Leadership**

**Compensation: $65-$75/HR. + Bonus**  
**Schedule:** Flexible | The greatest service need is generally during after-school and early evening hours, although opportunities may vary based on individual family needs.

**About Step Up Family Services:** At Step Up Family Services, we believe meaningful change begins with meeting individuals and families where they are. We provide individualized, high-quality behavioral health services that build on individual strengths and create lasting progress in the communities we serve.

Our Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services support children and families through evidence-based interventions delivered in home, center-based, and community settings. We are seeking dedicated BCBA/LBA professionals who are passionate about clinical excellence, developing Behavior Technicians, and helping children achieve meaningful outcomes.

**Why Join Our Team?**

* **Competitive Compensation:** $65–$75 per hour, plus bonus opportunities.
* **Flexible Scheduling:** Full-time, part-time, and per diem opportunities.
* **Professional Growth:** CEU reimbursement, ongoing development, and clinical leadership opportunities.
* **Supportive Team:** Collaborative clinical and operational support so you can focus on delivering high-quality care.

**Position Summary**: The **BCBA/LBA** provides clinical leadership and oversight of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services for children and families served by Step Up Family Services. This role is responsible for conducting assessments, developing and monitoring individualized treatment and Behavior Support Plans (BSPs), analyzing client progress, supervising and developing BTs/RBTs, and partnering with families to support meaningful and sustainable outcomes.

The BCBA/LBA is expected to exercise independent clinical decision-making while maintaining high standards of ethical practice, documentation, collaboration, and regulatory compliance.

**Schedule**

* Scheduling is based on assigned caseload, authorized service hours, client/family needs, and program availability
* Step Up provides services Monday through Sunday between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM
* During the school year, in-home service needs are primarily concentrated after school and on weekends
* Position may include in-home, center-based, community-based, and virtual clinical responsibilities, as appropriate to the service and case
* Travel to assigned client locations is required for in-home and community-based services

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive client assessments and Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) and use findings to identify treatment priorities and clinical recommendations.
* Develop, implement, monitor, and modify individualized treatment plans and Behavior Support Plans (BSPs) based on assessment findings, client needs, family input, and measurable clinical goals.
* Analyze client data and treatment outcomes to evaluate effectiveness, identify barriers to progress, and make data-informed clinical decisions and treatment modifications.
* Provide ongoing supervision, observation, coaching, and clinical direction to BTs/RBTs, ensuring treatment fidelity, staff competency, and appropriate implementation of treatment protocols.
* Partner with parents and caregivers through education, training, modeling, and ongoing communication to promote treatment consistency and generalization of skills across environments.
* Collaborate with families, BTs/RBTs, clinical leadership, schools, providers, and other members of the care team to support coordinated and clinically appropriate care.
* Maintain ownership of assigned caseloads, including authorized service hours, supervision requirements, scheduling, reassessments, treatment-plan updates, and required clinical documentation.
* Identify and appropriately respond to clinical, ethical, safety, or professional-boundary concerns, including consultation and escalation when necessary.
* Complete all clinical documentation, assessments, treatment plans, supervision records, and other required records accurately and within established timeframes, utilizing Step Up’s required electronic systems.
* Maintain compliance with BACB ethical requirements, New Jersey licensure requirements, payer/funding requirements, Step Up policies, and all applicable professional and regulatory standards.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or higher in Applied Behavior Analysis, Psychology, Education, or another qualifying related field.
* Demonstrated experience providing ABA services and developing individualized behavioral treatment interventions.
* Experience conducting FBAs, developing treatment/BSPs, analyzing clinical data, and modifying interventions based on client progress.
* Experience supervising, coaching, or developing BTs/RBTs or other direct-care clinical staff.
* Strong clinical decision-making, communication, organization, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively and independently across in-home and/or center-based environments while maintaining strong collaboration with families and the broader clinical team.
* Reliable transportation and ability to travel to assigned client homes, community settings, or Step Up centers as required.
* Must successfully meet all required background checks, fingerprinting, credentialing, training, and other employment requirements.
